scope: Remove an optional diagnostic from ordinary production builds without deleting its live validation capability.
go_basis: Go cmd/tidb-server builds the production server; this Rust-only manual diagnostic is test support, not another production server target.

validation.target_metadata: PASS: default-eligible binaries reduced from two to one; diagnostic requires explicit empty feature; dependency declarations, lockfile, source and finding dispositions unchanged
validation.shell_syntax: PASS: bash -n on both migrated runners
validation.publication: Actual commit hook and fresh locked pre-push build required; final-handoff.json records results.

explicit_diagnostic.command: cd rust && cargo build --locked -p tidb-server --features diagnostics --bin cluster-session-smoke --message-format=json

limitations: No live TiKV execution or release link; diagnostic source and output paths are unchanged, and both runner build commands enable diagnostics.
No whole-package acceptance or finding closure.
Artifact selection reduction is measurable; no full build-time or workload speedup claim.
decision: Use an empty required feature instead of an example target, avoiding activation of test-only dependencies for this manual tool.
recovered_issues: Initial optional diagnostic link exhausted disk; retired the completed default server executable and retried successfully. No dependency cache purge.

First CLI harness expected stderr to contain only the argument error; existing jemalloc warnings precede it. Corrected the external harness to assert exit status, empty stdout and the exact final error line; four checks then passed.
